_doc: Canonical digests of the float64 transcendental functions (dexengine.core.blas_pin.math_digests) per pin profile. The one owner of these values; blas_pin.math_check reads this file and compares the profile's gated functions (PROFILES[profile]['math']). Regenerate on the canonical host with: NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES=<profile npy_off> PYTHONPATH=. <profile python> -c 'from dexengine.core import blas_pin; print(blas_pin.math_digests())'.
